game_concept: A adventure race set in Coastal Port – Harbor Docks, busy wooden harbor docks: the sailor must handle rogue crabs while practicing conditionals (if / elif / else). Core idea – Not Negator: Use not to flip alarms and traps so the sailor slips through safely.
theme: Coastal Port – Harbor Docks: busy wooden harbor docks
core_gameplay_loop: In Harbor Docks, repeat each round: Use not to flip alarms and traps so the sailor slips through safely. Each round the rival advances, and solving the step moves the sailor ahead. Then check the stealth value and advance.
secondary_mechanics: Hint tokens that reveal one line of code
player_objective: Beat a rival AI to the cargo hold by solving code steps involving stealth that move the sailor forward.
controls: Mouse/touch: drag code blocks into the editor panel; SPACE runs the code; keys 1-4 pick answers.
win_condition: Player progress reaches 100% before the rival does (rival speed 0.8).
lose_condition: The rival reaches the cargo hold first, or lives reach 0.
learning_alignment: Week 3 – Conditionals (if / elif / else) | Level 7 (applied tier): Not Negator
assets_style: pixel-art harbor town: deep blue sea, wooden docks, orange-roofed buildings, sailing ships; flat Kenney-style sprites; sea-shanty accordion with wave and gull ambience
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Not Negator' (Week 3 slot 5), mission type 'Rival Race', and setting 'Harbor Docks'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: Coastal Port
region.mood: sea-shanty accordion with wave and gull ambience

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how stealth changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against rogue crabs in Harbor Docks.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: Player progress reaches 100% before the rival does (rival speed 0.8).
